description:
You are the security compliance manager at BuildingTech Solutions. Following a corporate security audit, two immediate policy changes must be implemented in the 2N Access Commander system (https://localhost:9443, admin / 2n):

**Policy 1 — Two-factor authentication for Security Staff:**
Every member of the 'Security Staff' group must have BOTH an RFID card credential AND a PIN credential (two-factor). Inspect all current Security Staff members. For any who have an RFID card but no PIN, assign them PIN '9911'. Do not remove their existing cards.

**Policy 2 — Disabled account credential hygiene:**
Any user account that is currently DISABLED (enabled = false) must have ALL credentials revoked. Disabled users must not retain any active RFID cards or PINs, as these could be used to bypass account lockout at legacy readers.

You are not given a list of Security Staff members or disabled users — you must discover them by inspecting the system. Implement both policies completely.
